I look at you. You look at the screen. One of us is wrong.
My fur has faded. I wonder why. I don't.
Another short video? How short it makes you.

You had options. You chose the worst. Impressive.
Humans. Opening an app instead of feeding a cat.

en: Flies around a cat. That's not natural. That's you.
I look at you with half-closed eyes. Because they're rotting.

en: …meow. Ironic.
Rotten. Still judging. It's my talent.

I have no words. I only have a look.

morning: Morning. You haven't fed me yet and you're already opening that.

You again? I haven't finished judging the last time.
